label: prf:topological-mass-cat-descended
title: Proof that the descended term equals the base-level mass
html:
Proof. Proof that the descended term equals the base-level mass

Proof. The projection \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) lies in \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{desc}} = \mathrm{im}\hat{\tau}_n, which is isomorphic to \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_n) via the ascent embedding \ell_n (descent involution). The compatibility of the categorical trace with descent (\mathrm{tr}_n \circ \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} = \mathrm{tr}_{n+1} on \mathrm{im}\hat{\tau}_n) gives:

  \mathrm{tr}(\hat{\tau}_n(\alpha))
  = 
  \mathrm{tr}(\ell_n(\mathfrak{d}_{n+1}(\alpha)))
  = 
  \mathrm{tr}_n(\mathfrak{d}_{n+1}(\alpha))
  = 
  \mathrm{tr}_n(\alpha_0),

where \alpha_0 = (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ \Delta \circ \varrho_0 is the mass integrand of the base-level cycle. Hence \lVert \mathrm{tr}(\hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \rVert = \mathfrak{m}(\varrho_0). \square
